source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Unit 4 (PDF 49-82), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 4 (Matrices & Determinants) ke poore unit se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke Section-II ke sawal ke hisse ki shakal mein: har sawal 5 number ka hai (lamba sawal, saboot (proof) ya derivation). Har sawal poore qadmon ke saath hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 If \(A = \begin{bmatrix}2 & -1 & 0 \\ 3 & 4 & 1\end{bmatrix}\) and \(B = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & -2 & 5\end{bmatrix}\), show that \((A - B)^{t} = A^{t} - B^{t}\). (5 marks)
(Agar \(A = \begin{bmatrix}2 & -1 & 0 \\ 3 & 4 & 1\end{bmatrix}\) aur \(B = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & -2 & 5\end{bmatrix}\) hon to sabit karein ke \((A - B)^{t} = A^{t} - B^{t}\).)
blocks.explanation: Dono taraf alag alag hal karein: pehle tafreeq phir transpose; pehle transpose phir tafreeq; phir muqabla.

book_ref.quote: The same is true for a difference

steps: (i) aur (ii) ka order \(3 \times 2\) aik hai aur mutabiq entries barabar hain

blocks.prompt:
2 If \(A = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 2\end{bmatrix}\), find the matrix \(X\) such that \(A^{2} - 3A + 2I - X = O\). (5 marks)
(Agar \(A = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 2\end{bmatrix}\) ho to matrix \(X\) nikalein jis ke liye \(A^{2} - 3A + 2I - X = O\).)
blocks.explanation: \(X = A^{2} - 3A + 2I\); pehle \(A^{2} = A \cdot A\) row-column se, phir entry ba entry jor.

book_ref.quote: Powers exist only for square matrices

blocks.prompt:
3 Verify the left distributive property \(A(B + C) = AB + AC\) for \(A = \begin{bmatrix}1 & -1 \\ 2 & 0\end{bmatrix}\), \(B = \begin{bmatrix}3 & 1 \\ 0 & 2\end{bmatrix}\), \(C = \begin{bmatrix}-1 & 2 \\ 4 & 1\end{bmatrix}\). (5 marks)
(\(A = \begin{bmatrix}1 & -1 \\ 2 & 0\end{bmatrix}\), \(B = \begin{bmatrix}3 & 1 \\ 0 & 2\end{bmatrix}\), \(C = \begin{bmatrix}-1 & 2 \\ 4 & 1\end{bmatrix}\) ke liye left distributive property \(A(B + C) = AB + AC\) ki tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Bayen taraf (pehle jama, phir zarb) aur dayen taraf (do zarb, phir jama) nikalein; A hamesha bayen rahe.

book_ref.quote: Left distributive property

blocks.prompt:
4 For \(A = \begin{bmatrix}2 & 1 & -1 \\ 3 & 0 & 2 \\ 1 & 4 & 1\end{bmatrix}\), find all nine cofactors. Hence find \(|A|\) by expanding along \(R_{1}\) and along \(C_{3}\). (5 marks)
(\(A = \begin{bmatrix}2 & 1 & -1 \\ 3 & 0 & 2 \\ 1 & 4 & 1\end{bmatrix}\) ke tamam nau cofactors nikalein. Phir \(R_{1}\) aur \(C_{3}\) dono ke saath phaila kar \(|A|\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(A_{ij} = (-1)^{i+j}M_{ij}\) shatranj wale nishanaat ke saath; phir kisi bhi line ke saath (element) \(\times\) (us ka cofactor) jama karein.

book_ref.quote: These are used again in 4.4.2

blocks.prompt:
5 Find the values of \(x\) for which \(\begin{vmatrix}x & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & x & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & x\end{vmatrix} = 0\). (5 marks)
(\(x\) ki woh qeematein nikalein jin ke liye \(\begin{vmatrix}x & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & x & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & x\end{vmatrix} = 0\).)
blocks.explanation: Pehli row ke saath phailayein (is mein sifar hai), cubic ke factors banayein aur hal karein.

book_ref.quote: is the required expansion of determinant of square matrix of order 3

steps: \(R_{1}\) ke saath phailayein: \(\begin{vmatrix}x & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & x & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & x\end{vmatrix} = x\begin{vmatrix}x & 1 \\ 1 & x\end{vmatrix} - 1\begin{vmatrix}1 & 1 \\ 0 & x\end{vmatrix} + 0\)

blocks.prompt:
6 Without expansion, show that \(\begin{vmatrix}a & b & c \\ b + c & c + a & a + b \\ 1 & 1 & 1\end{vmatrix} = 0\). (5 marks)
(Phailaye baghair sabit karein ke \(\begin{vmatrix}a & b & c \\ b + c & c + a & a + b \\ 1 & 1 & 1\end{vmatrix} = 0\).)
blocks.explanation: Properties se do rows aik jaisi banayein: R1 ko R2 mein jama karein, mushtarik factor nikalein, R3 se muqabla karein.

book_ref.quote: Two uses of v: a common factor of a row or column can be taken outside the determinant

steps: \(R_{2} + R_{1} \to R_{2}\) (property vii, qeemat wahi): \(R_{2}\) ban jati hai \((a + b + c,\ a + b + c,\ a + b + c)\)
\(= \begin{vmatrix}a & b & c \\ a + b + c & a + b + c & a + b + c \\ 1 & 1 & 1\end{vmatrix}\)
\(R_{2}\) se \(a + b + c\) bahar nikalein (property v): \(= (a + b + c)\begin{vmatrix}a & b & c \\ 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 1\end{vmatrix}\)
\(R_{2}\) aur \(R_{3}\) aik jaisi hain, is liye determinant \(0\) (property iii)

blocks.prompt:
7 Show that \(\begin{vmatrix}1 + a & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 + b & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 1 + c\end{vmatrix} = abc + ab + bc + ca\). (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke \(\begin{vmatrix}1 + a & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 + b & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 1 + c\end{vmatrix} = abc + ab + bc + ca\).)
blocks.explanation: Row operations se sifar banayein (qeemat wahi), phir sifar wali row ke saath phailayein.

book_ref.quote: This is how zeros are created before expanding.

steps: \(R_{1} - R_{3} \to R_{1}\), \(R_{2} - R_{3} \to R_{2}\) (property vii): \(\begin{vmatrix}a & 0 & -c \\ 0 & b & -c \\ 1 & 1 & 1 + c\end{vmatrix}\)
\(R_{1}\) ke saath phailayein: \(= a\begin{vmatrix}b & -c \\ 1 & 1 + c\end{vmatrix} - 0 + (-c)\begin{vmatrix}0 & b \\ 1 & 1\end{vmatrix}\)
blocks.final_answer: Sabit hua: determinant \(= abc + ab + bc + ca\)

blocks.prompt:
8 Show that \(\begin{vmatrix}x & y & x + y \\ y & x + y & x \\ x + y & x & y\end{vmatrix} = -2(x^{3} + y^{3})\). (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke \(\begin{vmatrix}x & y & x + y \\ y & x + y & x \\ x + y & x & y\end{vmatrix} = -2(x^{3} + y^{3})\).)
blocks.explanation: Har row ka jama 2(x + y) hai: ise pehle column mein jama karein, bahar nikalein, sifar banayein aur phailayein.

book_ref.quote: Adding \(k\) times one row (column) to another: value unchanged

steps: \(C_{1} + C_{2} + C_{3} \to C_{1}\) (property vii): \(C_{1}\) ki har entry \(2(x + y)\) ban jati hai
\(C_{1}\) se \(2(x + y)\) bahar nikalein: \(= 2(x + y)\begin{vmatrix}1 & y & x + y \\ 1 & x + y & x \\ 1 & x & y\end{vmatrix}\)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: \(x^{3} + y^{3} = (x + y)(x^{2} - xy + y^{2})\) ka purana formula aakhri qadam mein istemal hua. Pehla qadam is liye kaam karta hai ke har row ka jama \(x + y + (x + y) = 2(x + y)\) hai.

blocks.prompt:
9 Find \(A^{-1}\) by the adjoint method if \(A = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 1 & 3 & 4\end{bmatrix}\), and verify that \(AA^{-1} = I_{3}\). (5 marks)
(Adjoint method se \(A^{-1}\) nikalein agar \(A = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 1 & 3 & 4\end{bmatrix}\), aur tasdeeq karein ke \(AA^{-1} = I_{3}\).)
blocks.explanation: \(A^{-1} = \dfrac{1}{|A|}\operatorname{adj} A\): determinant, nau cofactors, transpose, taqseem, check.

book_ref.quote: Find all nine cofactors \(A_{ij} = (-1)^{i+j}M_{ij}\).

blocks.prompt:
10 For \(A = \begin{bmatrix}2 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 3 & 1\end{bmatrix}\), find \(\operatorname{adj} A\) and verify that \(A(\operatorname{adj} A) = |A|\,I_{3}\). (5 marks)
(\(A = \begin{bmatrix}2 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 3 & 1\end{bmatrix}\) ke liye \(\operatorname{adj} A\) nikalein aur tasdeeq karein ke \(A(\operatorname{adj} A) = |A|\,I_{3}\).)
blocks.explanation: |A| aur adjoint nikalein, phir zarb dein: har diagonal entry |A| aur baqi har entry 0 honi chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
11 Find the inverse of \(A = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 0 \\ 2 & 5 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2\end{bmatrix}\) by elementary row operations. (5 marks)
(Elementary row operations se \(A = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 0 \\ 2 & 5 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2\end{bmatrix}\) ka inverse nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(|A| \ne 0\) dekhein, phir \(A \vdots I_{3}\) ko \(I_{3} \vdots A^{-1}\) mein badlein; har operation poori row par.

book_ref.quote: Writing all three right sides next to

steps: Bayan hissa \(I_{3}\) ban gaya; dayan hissa \(A^{-1}\) hai

blocks.prompt:
12 Reduce \(\begin{bmatrix}2 & 4 & -2 & 2 \\ 1 & 3 & 1 & 4 \\ 3 & 7 & 0 & 8\end{bmatrix}\) to echelon form and to reduced echelon form. (5 marks)
(\(\begin{bmatrix}2 & 4 & -2 & 2 \\ 1 & 3 & 1 & 4 \\ 3 & 7 & 0 & 8\end{bmatrix}\) ko echelon form aur reduced echelon form mein layein.)
blocks.explanation: Har row mein leading 1 aur us ke neeche sifar banayein (echelon); phir har leading 1 ke oopar bhi sifar (reduced).

book_ref.quote: Echelon form is enough to find a rank

blocks.prompt:
13 Find the rank of \(\begin{bmatrix}1 & -1 & 2 & 0 \\ 2 & 1 & 1 & 3 \\ 1 & 2 & -1 & 3 \\ 3 & 0 & 3 & 3\end{bmatrix}\). (5 marks)
(\(\begin{bmatrix}1 & -1 & 2 & 0 \\ 2 & 1 & 1 & 3 \\ 1 & 2 & -1 & 3 \\ 3 & 0 & 3 & 3\end{bmatrix}\) ka rank nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Echelon form mein layein aur ghair-sifar rows ginein.

book_ref.quote: The rank counts how many rows carry genuinely new information.

blocks.prompt:
14 Solve by reducing the augmented matrix to reduced echelon form: \(x + y + z = 6,\ 2x - y + z = 3,\ x + 2y - z = 2\). (5 marks)
(Augmented matrix ko reduced echelon form mein la kar hal karein: \(x + y + z = 6,\ 2x - y + z = 3,\ x + 2y - z = 2\).)
blocks.explanation: Poore augmented matrix (constants samet) ko reduce karein jab tak coefficient hissa identity na ban jaye; phir aakhri column parhein.

blocks.prompt:
15 Show that the system \(x + y - z = 2,\ 2x + 3y + z = 7,\ 3x + 4y = 9\) is consistent and find its general solution. (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke nizam \(x + y - z = 2,\ 2x + 3y + z = 7,\ 3x + 4y = 9\) consistent hai aur is ka aam hal nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Augmented matrix reduce karein, dono ranks ka variables ki tadaad se muqabla karein, aur azad variable ko t likhein.

book_ref.quote: In system (ii), the rank of the coefficient matrix is the same as that of the augmented matrix

steps: Coefficient matrix ka rank = augmented matrix ka rank = 2 < 3: consistent, be-shumar hal
blocks.final_answer: \(x = 4t - 1,\ y = 3 - 3t,\ z = t\), \(t\) koi bhi haqeeqi number

blocks.prompt:
16 Use the matrix inversion method to solve \(x + 2y = -1,\ 2x + 5y + z = -1,\ y + 2z = 3\). (5 marks)
(Matrix inversion method se hal karein: \(x + 2y = -1,\ 2x + 5y + z = -1,\ y + 2z = 3\).)
blocks.explanation: \(AX = B\) likhein, \(|A| \ne 0\) dekhein, \(A^{-1} = \dfrac{1}{|A|}\operatorname{adj} A\) nikalein, phir \(X = A^{-1}B\).

17 Solve by Cramer's rule: \(x - y + z = 2,\ 2x + y - z = 1,\ x + 2y + 2z = 11\). (5 marks)
(Cramer's rule se hal karein: \(x - y + z = 2,\ 2x + y - z = 1,\ x + 2y + 2z = 11\).)
blocks.explanation: \(x_{k} = \dfrac{D_{k}}{|A|}\): \(|A|\) ka column \(k\) constants se badlein; pehle \(|A| \ne 0\) dekhein.

blocks.prompt:
18 For the system \(a_{i1}x_{1} + a_{i2}x_{2} + a_{i3}x_{3} = b_{i}\) (\(i = 1, 2, 3\)) with \(|A| \ne 0\), derive Cramer's rule. (5 marks)
(Nizam \(a_{i1}x_{1} + a_{i2}x_{2} + a_{i3}x_{3} = b_{i}\) (\(i = 1, 2, 3\)) ke liye, jab \(|A| \ne 0\), Cramer's rule derive karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(X = A^{-1}B\) aur \(A^{-1} = \dfrac{1}{|A|}\operatorname{adj} A\) se shuru karein; har numerator ko kisi column ke saath phailaya gaya determinant pehchanein.

book_ref.quote: We have already proved that

steps: Nizam ko \(AX = B\) likhein; agar \(|A| \ne 0\) to \(X = A^{-1}B = \dfrac{1}{|A|}(\operatorname{adj} A)B\)
\(x_{1} = \dfrac{b_{1}A_{11} + b_{2}A_{21} + b_{3}A_{31}}{|A|}\); \(A_{11}, A_{21}, A_{31}\) column 1 ke cofactors hain aur in mein column 1 shamil nahi
Is liye numerator \(\begin{vmatrix}b_{1} & a_{12} & a_{13} \\ b_{2} & a_{22} & a_{23} \\ b_{3} & a_{32} & a_{33}\end{vmatrix} = D_{1}\) ka column 1 ke saath phailao hai
Isi tarah \(x_{2}\) ka numerator \(b_{1}A_{12} + b_{2}A_{22} + b_{3}A_{32} = D_{2}\) (column 2 badla) aur \(x_{3}\) ka \(D_{3}\) (column 3 badla)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Asal nukta: \(A_{11}, A_{21}, A_{31}\) banate waqt column 1 hata diya jata hai, is liye column 1 mein \(b_{1}, b_{2}, b_{3}\) rakhne se yeh cofactors nahi badalte. Is liye \(b_{1}A_{11} + b_{2}A_{21} + b_{3}A_{31}\) bilkul us naye determinant ka column 1 ke saath phailao hai.

blocks.prompt:
19 Solve by Gaussian elimination: \(x + 2y - z = 0,\ 2x + y + z = 0,\ x - y + 2z = 0\). (5 marks)
(Gaussian elimination se hal karein: \(x + 2y - z = 0,\ 2x + y + z = 0,\ x - y + 2z = 0\).)
blocks.explanation: Augmented matrix ko row-echelon form mein layein, rank parhein, aur azad variable ke saath back substitution karein.

book_ref.quote: It involves performing a series of row operations on the system's augmented matrix

steps: Row-echelon form mein 2 ghair-sifar rows: \(A\) ka rank \(= 2 < 3\), is liye non-trivial hal hain (Rule II)
Back substitution: \(y - z = 0 \Rightarrow y = z\); \(x + 2y - z = 0 \Rightarrow x = -2z + z = -z\); \(z = t\) rakhein
blocks.final_answer: \(x = -t,\ y = t,\ z = t\), koi bhi \(t\) (\(t \ne 0\) par non-trivial)

blocks.prompt:
20 Find \(\lambda\) so that \(x + 2y + z = 0,\ 2x - y + 3z = 0,\ 3x + y + \lambda z = 0\) has a non-trivial solution, and find that solution. (5 marks)
(\(\lambda\) aisa nikalein ke \(x + 2y + z = 0,\ 2x - y + 3z = 0,\ 3x + y + \lambda z = 0\) ka non-trivial hal ho, aur woh hal nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Non-trivial hal ke liye rank 3 se kam, yani \(|A| = 0\); \(\lambda\) nikalein, phir Gaussian elimination se hal karein.

book_ref.quote: Homogeneous system of linear equation has non-trivial solution if rank of

steps: Non-trivial hal ke liye rank \(< 3\), yani \(|A| = \begin{vmatrix}1 & 2 & 1 \\ 2 & -1 & 3 \\ 3 & 1 & \lambda\end{vmatrix} = 0\)

blocks.prompt:
21 A triangle has vertices \(P(1, 4)\), \(Q(-3, 2)\) and \(R(5, -1)\). Find the vertices of its reflection in the line \(y = x\) using a transformation matrix. (5 marks)
(Aik tikon ke rukn \(P(1, 4)\), \(Q(-3, 2)\) aur \(R(5, -1)\) hain. Transformation matrix se line \(y = x\) mein is ke aks ke rukn nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har rukn ko 2 x 1 column likhein aur bayen se y = x ke reflection matrix se zarb dein.

book_ref.quote: Transformation or Reflection Matrix is a mathematical tool

steps: \(y = x\) mein reflection \(\begin{bmatrix}0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0\end{bmatrix}\) se hota hai; har rukn ko column likhein
Check: \(y = x\) mein reflection coordinates badal deta hai: \((1, 4) \to (4, 1)\), \((-3, 2) \to (2, -3)\), \((5, -1) \to (-1, 5)\)

blocks.prompt:
22 Use \(A = \begin{bmatrix}2 & 1 \\ 1 & 1\end{bmatrix}\) to encode the message HELP (A to Z = 1 to 26), and decode the result to check it. (5 marks)
(\(A = \begin{bmatrix}2 & 1 \\ 1 & 1\end{bmatrix}\) se paigham HELP encode karein (A se Z = 1 se 26), aur natija decode kar ke check karein.)
blocks.explanation: Huroof ko numbers banayein, do do ke \(2 \times 1\) columns banayein, har aik ko \(A\) se zarb dein; \(A^{-1}\) se decode.

book_ref.quote: It is often used to hide the actual meaning of a message.

steps: HELP do do ke group: HE, LP; H = 8, E = 5, L = 12, P = 16: \(\begin{bmatrix}8 \\ 5\end{bmatrix}, \begin{bmatrix}12 \\ 16\end{bmatrix}\)
